explanation.headline: Fludarabine phosphate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted 2022-05-06 and is resolved

sentences.text: FDA's records show fludarabine phosphate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the prior shortage was first posted 2022-05-06 and is now resolved.
A separate label for Areva Pharmaceuticals names NerPharMa SRL (FEI 3004762406) as a registered manufacturing plant with a VAI inspection ending 2024-09-13.
FDA inspection history for NerPharMa SRL shows multiple VAI classifications, the most recent classification letter dated 2024-12-12 for an inspection that ended 2024-09-13.
No FDA regulatory action dated before the 2022-05-06 shortage posting is recorded for the ACTAVIS TOTOWA plant that supplies our NDC.

The recommended action is to transfer 18 vials of the 50 mg/2 mL presentation from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East's supply from 4.4 days to 10 days while Corvale General retains 14 days.

rejected.text: The product used at Corvale General and Corvale East carries NDC 45963060955 and is labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc. with manufacturing at ACTAVIS TOTOWA.
rejected.reason: Actavis Pharma, Inc. is named only as the application's sponsor, not as a manufacturing plant
